plan.goal: Size a PLINK binary genotype dataset: report total .bed size, per-chromosome .bed size for the largest chromosome, and the number of per-chromosome files for a 1145-sample, 4829115-variant GWAS.
plan.rationale: PLINK binary .bed packs 2 bits per sample per variant, so total size = n_samples × n_variants / 4 / 1e6 MB. Per-chromosome size uses the same rule applied to the largest chromosome's variant count (756533). The number of per-chromosome files equals the number of chromosomes in the dataset; for a standard human GWAS this is 25 (22 autosomes + X + Y + MT), consistent with the largest chromosome carrying 756533 variants and the total of 4829115 spanning the full chromosome set.
caveats: Per-chromosome .bed size (216.56 MB) is for the largest chromosome (756533 variants); smaller chromosomes are proportionally smaller.
Number of per-chromosome files assumes a standard human 25-chromosome set (22 autosomes + X + Y + MT); confirm against the actual build before scripting jobs.
The 2-bits rule covers the .bed binary only; .bim and .fam files add a small additional footprint not included.
